messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up  change window opens in ~6m. Rolling plan: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% (3m intervals). Baseline p95=95ms, error rate=0.02%. This rollout includes rerank-v2 which touches embed route. Reply :ok_hand: to approve.
taylor: Approved. One request: throttle/rate-hold at 25% if rerank p99 > 400ms or embed 5xx > 7/min. Logging a watch.
maya: Noted. I've enabled KV sticky prefill (`kv.prefill=sticky`) and disabled bulk pre-warm on core hosts. Also toggling canary debug header `X-Canary-Debug:1` for sampling.
sam: Quick check: `rate(http_requests_total{route=\"embed\",status=~\"5..\"}[1m]) * 60` shows ~0.05/min right now, but we saw a 4/min spike ~5m ago. Will monitor.
deploy-bot: Shifted traffic to 5% at 1735554360. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/rollouts/1735554360. Auto-hold thresholds are active.
obs-bot: SOFT ALERT at 1735554375  rerank-v2 tail p99 = 420ms (>400ms). Action: PAUSE rollout at current traffic. Notifying @backend-oncall and @release-coordinator. :rotating_light:
backend-oncall: Oncall here. Traces show upstream embed service throttling. Mitigation: reducing embed concurrency for canary with `embed.max_concurrency=8`. Standing by.
release-coordinator: I'll capture this: "Hold at 5% due to rerank p99 spike; mitigation = embed concurrency throttle + KV prefill change."
taylor: If p99 doesn't fall < 350ms and embed 5xx < 3/min within 6m we rollback to v2026.03.08. Otherwise resume to 25%.
maya: Pushing a config tweak now  lowering rerank batch size to 16 (`rerank.batch_size=16`). Patch ETA ~90s.
obs-bot: UPDATE at 1735554450  rerank p99 improved to 330ms, embed 5xx down to 2/min. Recommendation: resume rollout to next stage or extend hold +3m. :thumbsup:
sam: +1 to resume to 25%. I'll keep an eye on traces and queue depth for the next 10m.
release-coordinator: Resuming to 25% at 1735554470 per consensus. Added detailed note to changelog and release notes: "paused during canary for rerank tail; mitigations applied; resumed after stability check." :white_check_mark:
